cards.name: Kor, Cause of Vengeance
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you attack, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw a card, then Klingons and Warriors you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Locutus of Borg
cards.oracle_text:
Lifelink
Artifact creatures you control have "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 1/1 colorless Borg artifact creature token."

cards.name: Lt. Arex, Ever-Adapting
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Strange new worlds — Lt. Arex's power and toughness are each equal to the number of differently named lands you control.
When Lt. Arex enters, draw three cards. You may put up to three land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: McCoy, Not a Bricklayer
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever McCoy or another Doctor you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Creatures you control with counters on them have lifelink.

cards.name: One, Borg Evolved
cards.oracle_text: Artifact creatures you control have flying, double strike, vigilance, menace, lifelink, and ward {2}.

cards.name: Pavel Chekov, First Posting
cards.oracle_text: If you would draw a card, you may instead choose land or nonland and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Reg Barclay, Fidgety Fantasist
cards.oracle_text: Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it isn't legendary, it's an Illusion artifact in addition to its other types, and it has haste. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Rite of Ascension
cards.oracle_text: Battlefront — Whenever you attack, for each opponent you attacked this turn, create a tapped and attacking 2/1 red Klingon Warrior creature token with haste.

cards.name: Sins of the Father
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
II — For each opponent, you create a 2/1 red Klingon Warrior creature token with haste.
III — Exile target player's graveyard. Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards exiled this way.

cards.name: Tom Paris, Risk-Taker
cards.oracle_text: Seek out — Whenever you draw your second card each turn, creatures you control gain flying, double strike, vigilance, and haste until end of turn.
